3755-4770-6090-7060.description:

Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.

141-728-1854.description:
Cast Makeshift Mannequin by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.

Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Makeshift Mannequin
Resolve the Makeshift Mannequin copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.

Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.

Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Footsteps of the Goryo
Resolve the Footsteps of the Goryo copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Relic of Legends by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.

Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.

Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the token creature, adding one colored mana.

Repeat.

2511-7936--5.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dominion Saboteur.
When Dominion Saboteur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. Choose to have it enter as a copy of the creature with persist with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from Dominion Saboteur as a state-based action.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Sage of Hours.

Resolve the Sage of Hours trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Faces of the Past trigger, untapping all Humans and Wizards.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

Activate Evereth by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Evereth ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.
586-1594-5258-5618-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, scrying 1.
Repeat.

If the sacrificed creature was a Devil token, it triggers when it dies, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat each combat phase.

When the creature token enters, Mighty Mutanimals' second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 4.
